page.title: Widget Service v2 Tracker
page.eyebrow: Release 2.0 · widget service · target date set after M1
page.plan: The team ships v2 of the widget service. It splits the API from the worker, moves storage to a new database, and releases one container image. Go gate: a full rehearsal on a staging cluster. Spec: docs/specs/widget-v2.md.
page.sessions_note: Sessions: api-build (API and worker), db-migrate (schema and data), ops-pack (image, pipeline, rehearsal). The orchestrator integrates, merges into the release branch and runs the rehearsal.
page.outsiders: the platform team, the support lead, you
